claire_radar.motivation: Rule-following agents tasked with executing policies and regulations often fail via Silent Scope Omission (SSO): a model applies a general rule but silently drops nested exceptions or counter-exceptions, producing outputs that appear compliant yet break on important edge cases.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Silent Scope Omission is a critical failure in rule-following agents. NormBench provides a diagnostic benchmark to identify structural omissions and improve statutory understanding in LLMs.
